text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH - GPU pool eu-west-1 is at 100% utilization and request queue length > 120s for multiple tenants. Autoscaler failing to create new nodes (scale errors reported). Paging on-call: @oncall-alex :rotating_light:

oncall-alex: seeing it, joining now. Can someone paste the autoscaler logs?

eng-sre-jordan: grabbing logs from cluster-ops. Preliminary error is `QuotaExceeded` from provider when requesting new gpus. Also seeing repeated `node-provision-timeout` in controller logs.

runtime-dev-sam: queue growth is causing backlog on the generation service. Some requests are being throttled with 429s at our edge. Customer impact: premium tenants in eu-west experiencing timeouts.

infra-ops-lin: confirming provider side: our quota shows 0 available GPUs in eu-west-1 for the SKU we're trying to spin. Opening ticket with provider now (INC-1729). ETA unknown.

product-ops-maya: flagging that two large customers (alpha and beta) reported degraded service via CS. Raja, can you surface to them and offer mitigation?

customer-success-raja: on it. Notifying affected accounts and offering temporary traffic shaping guidance. Will update with any escalation requests.

oncall-alex: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) enable fallback model variant (smaller quantized) for non-critical routes, 2) route new requests to other regions (eu-central) where capacity exists, 3) spin up dedicated reserved instances if provider can allocate. Which can we do fastest?

runtime-dev-sam: fastest is fallback variant toggle. We have a per-route config flag. I can flip for public routes in ~2m. Need @eng-sre-jordan to update routing rules for pinned tenants to allow cross-region failover.

eng-sre-jordan: will update routing policy to allow eu->eu-central spillover for non-data-sensitive tenants. Pushing a canary now to 5% traffic.

ops-bot: deploy started: rollout/route-spillover canary -> 5% at 1778882450 (logs: https://internal/rollouts/1778).

oncall-alex: enabling fallback model for public generation endpoints now. Sam, please post the exact toggle so we can audit.

runtime-dev-sam: command: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/admin/route-config -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"gpt-small-quantized","enabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'``` Doing it.

ops-bot: rollout note: fallback model toggle applied to /v1/generate (public) at 1778882483.

eng-sre-jordan: canary traffic to eu-central at 5% is healthy so far — latency up ~30ms but error rate down. Queue length in eu-west starting to decrease.

infra-ops-lin: provider ticket updated: they confirm quota exhaustion due to a regional maintenance. They can free capacity if we accept older GPU SKU (v2) instead of v3. That would require model quantization compatibility checks.

runtime-dev-sam: v2 GPUs support our current runtime after a small kernel flag. We need to deploy a compatibility build to the pool image. Can do a hotbuild, but risk is higher. Recommend using fallback models primarily and keep reserved capacity as last resort.

oncall-alex: agreed. Priority: minimize customer 429s. Keep flow: fallback model -> cross-region spillover -> provider v2 allocation if still needed -> reserved capacity.

product-ops-maya: logging customer messaging draft: "We're routing some workload to alternate models/regions to reduce timeouts; performance impact ~+30ms; no data movement outside EU for flagged tenants." Raja please confirm before send.

customer-success-raja: message approved, sending to affected customers now.

eng-sre-jordan: monitoring: eu-west queue dropped from 120s median to 12s after 30% traffic moved. Error rate for premium tenants down from 18%->3%.

oncall-alex: nice work. Let's capture action items while incident is hot: 1) Postmortem + timeline (OWNER: jJordan) 2) Autoscaler should fallback to alternate SKU if quota errors persist (OWNER: lin) 3) Improve alerting to include provider quota metrics (OWNER: sam) 4) Runbook: automate cross-region spillover for non-SLA sensitive tenants (OWNER: jJordan & maya) 5) Customer communication post-incident (OWNER: raja).

eng-sre-jordan: assigning items in the tracker now. I added a timeline draft in the incident doc.

infra-ops-lin: opening a provider support case for increasing soft quota and asking for preemptive capacity notice. Also will prototype autoscaler logic to detect `QuotaExceeded` and attempt alternate SKU.

runtime-dev-sam: adding alert thresholds: queue length >60s OR sustained 80% GPU utilization for 5m should trigger early mitigation play. Will also add a synthetic test hitting eu-west serving path.

oncall-alex: any outstanding customer escalations?

customer-success-raja: one premium tenant asked to escalate to enterprise support; we routed them to dedicated capacity offer and scheduled a follow-up call.

eng-sre-jordan: final note: incident declared resolved at 1778882695 — queues stabilized after 40% spillover + fallback model. We'll keep monitoring for 6h and then run the postmortem sync. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED - GPU pool eu-west-1 saturation mitigated. Summary: fallback model route toggle + cross-region spillover reduced queue and error rates; provider quota prevents usual autoscaler path. Postmortem assigned to eng-sre-jordan.

oncall-alex: thanks team. Postmortem sync scheduled in #incidents-postmortems tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Follow-ups in tracker. :handshake:
